text:
Aisha K.: Heads-up — PR #3421 updated tool-calling examples for v2 but the structured-output snippets are now failing on the docs preview. docs-preview shows JSON schema fails in the 'parse examples' page. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421
Jared: saw that — errors come from the new `structured_output: true` flag plus schema `"additionalProperties": false`. examples that relied on extra keys break. short-term: relax schema or show strict vs permissive examples.
Liam: we should prefer showing strict schema but add a migration note. users migrating from v1 need a 1-line shim. propose adding a "compatibility" snippet.
Nora: I can update the SDK snippets (py/ts) — which files? Aisha, can you paste failing output logs?
Aisha K.: pasted logs in PR thread. main failures: example "create_report" returns `metadata: {version: 1}` which is rejected by schema. stack trace included.
Jared: short patch idea — update example schema to allow `metadata` as nullable object and add a comment about `additionalProperties`.
Nora: I'll send a small PR that adds a permissive example and another strict one, and add migration note titled 'V1 -> V2 tool/func calling changes'.
docs-bot: docs-preview build failed for PR #3421 — /docs/guide/structured-output.html (examples-run step) :x:
Aisha K.: can we also fix the Python snippet using `client.chat.generate(..., function_calls=True)` — SDK v3 removed that parameter, needs `tool_calling=True` per SDK 3.2.0. that's why samples were copied from older docs.
Liam: good catch. add a note in the migration guide: python/ts diffs, callouts for `tool_calling` param and `response.parse()` usage.
Jared: also broken link: old "function-calling" anchor moved to /guides/tool-calling; search-and-fix in repo.
Nora: will patch snippets + add a tiny smoke test in docs CI to run example code via `docs/examples/run.sh` and assert exit 0.
Aisha K.: assign reviewers: @Jared and @Liam. target merge by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
Jared: I'll review tonight. quick checklist: update schema examples, update SDK snippets, add migration note, fix anchors, run preview.
Liam: I'll add the migration checklist to the docs PR template so we don't miss this again.
Nora: PR coming in ~1h. tagging @docs-bot for preview re-run when ready. :rocket:
docs-bot: PR 3422 queued for preview build.
Aisha K.: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. plan to ship before the scheduled docs freeze. :shipit:
